name: FPV strike drone (family)
origin: Ukraine and Russia (mass-produced by both sides from commercial components)
armament: One small anti-armour or fragmentation warhead (game abstraction)
Bomber variants drop small munitions from a hover
protection: None. Game: one hit from any calibre or a shotgun brings it down; jammed by EW support assets (fibre-optic variant ignores jamming but trails a visible spool line). Proposal: an FPV hit counts as a light launcher hit against vehicles (disables tracks, wheels, optics; penetrates roofs and rear decks of light armour) and is lethal to infantry in the open.
visual_notes: Small X-frame quadcopter (7-10 inch propellers) with a cylindrical warhead strapped under or in front of the frame
Bright antennas at the rear; fibre-optic version carries a spool canister under the body and leaves a thin line
Heavy bomber variant is a 1-1.5 m hexa/octocopter with drop mechanism under the body (used at night)
Audio cue matters more than the model: high-pitched buzz rising as it dives
